comment: M12→M13 canonical domain-event contract (Forms spec §27/§28; frozen, append-only). Consumers receive these through the M07 outbox envelope with at-least-once delivery and dedupe on event id. Payload keys are exhaustive — new optional keys require an append-only fixture update. Forbidden in payloads: form payload values and any PII (email, phone, name, ip, tokens).

envelope.payload: JSON object matching the payload_keys below

FormSubmitted.emitted: after an ACCEPTED FormSubmission is persisted, same transaction

QuizCompleted.emitted: after a QuizRun transitions to COMPLETED, same transaction

LeadCreated.emitted: after a Lead row is created, same transaction as its source interaction

LeadStatusChanged.emitted: after a lead status transition via the privileged API
